aboutGame.title: What is Once Upon A Katamari?
paragraphs: Once Upon A Katamari is a colorful rolling puzzle action game developed by RENGAME and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. You play as the Prince, rolling a sticky Katamari through themed worlds to collect everyday objects, grow your ball, and rebuild the night sky after the King of All Cosmos accidentally destroys the stars.

The adventure travels through the Jurassic Period, the Ice Age, historic Japan, and other eras, mixing solo size-target stages with the four-player KatamariBall sport. Along the way you unlock 68 cousins, hunt 248 collectibles including Crowns and Presents, and customize your character with costumes and unlockable faces.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Once Upon A Katamari.

items.question: What is Once Upon A Katamari?
items.answer: Once Upon A Katamari is a rolling puzzle action game developed by RENGAME and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. You play as the Prince, rolling a sticky Katamari through history to collect objects, rebuild the night sky, and unlock 68 cousins.

items.question: What platforms is Once Upon A Katamari available on?
items.answer: Once Upon A Katamari launched on October 24, 2025 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam, with a Nintendo Switch 2 release following alongside the Rolling Live Highlights DLC.

items.question: How many cousins can you unlock in Once Upon A Katamari?
items.answer: There are 68 cousins to collect in Once Upon A Katamari. Gathering all of them unlocks two later levels as well as related trophies and achievements, so the cousin hunt is a progression gate rather than a side activity.

items.question: How many collectibles are in Once Upon A Katamari?
items.answer: Once Upon A Katamari contains 248 collectibles in total: 141 Crowns, 68 cousins, and 39 Presents. Cousins are usually the last category players finish because several only appear after specific stage conditions.

items.question: Does Once Upon A Katamari have multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. The four-player KatamariBall mode in Once Upon A Katamari pits you against online cousins worldwide or CPU opponents offline, and the magnet tool lets you pull nearby objects before your rivals reach them.

items.question: What does the Rolling Live Highlights DLC add to Once Upon A Katamari?
items.answer: Rolling Live Highlights adds 10 new quests, 12 BGM tracks, 6 new cousins, and 18 costume items to Once Upon A Katamari. The Royal Sound Edition bundles that DLC with the base game for players who want the extra soundtrack content.
